title: 4chan whistleblower: a decade working on crash retrievals
summary: Chris Ramsay tells of 4chan whistleblower: a decade working on crash retrievals, about late 1990s-2000s (posted early 2023) at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: A guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, Chris Ramsay, retells a post put up in early 2023 on 4chan, an anonymous online message board, by someone calling himself a whistleblower. According to Ramsay, the poster said he had spent about a decade, in the late 1990s and early 2000s, working on recovering crashed craft. If true, it would mean the US quietly runs a programme collecting crashed objects that are not ours.
